○ Token Currency Reform

■ Introduced copper coins due to silver shortage.

■ Failure: Led to widespread counterfeiting.

○ Taxation in Doab

■ Increased land tax in the fertile Doab region.

■ Failure: Coincided with famine, causing revolts.

○ Shifting Capital to Daulatabad

■ Moved capital from Delhi to Daulatabad.

■ Failure: Caused hardship; later reversed.

○ Agricultural Reforms (Diwan-i-Kohi)

■ Loans to farmers to cultivate barren land.

■ Failure: Poor planning; abandoned due to financial losses.

○ Military Expansion

■ Ambitious campaigns in Central Asia.

■ Failure: Drained resources, no lasting success.

○ Revenue Reforms

■ Streamlined revenue collection and imposed house taxes.

■ Failure: Led to widespread discontent.

○ Promotion of Trade

■ Improved trade routes and infrastructure.

■ Failure: Other failed policies overshadowed benefits.

○ Agricultural Loans (Taqavi)

■ Loans to farmers for seeds/tools after famine.

■ Mixed success: Some benefit, but corruption hindered results.

○ Irrigation Projects

■ Built canals for improved agriculture.

■ Limited success: Poor execution.
